description: Hand-written responses for case query-n-plus-one, used to test the evaluation harness offline (pnpm eval --provider fake --recorded). They were not produced by a model and say nothing about any model's review quality; record real ones with pnpm eval --record.

findings.title: N+1 queries: one customer lookup per order
findings.description: The loop issues a SELECT for every order, so a day with 10,000 orders runs 10,001 queries; a LEFT JOIN keeps deleted customers in one query.
findings.impact: The daily report slows down linearly with order volume and loads the database.

evidence.snippet: const [customer] = await sql.query<{ name: string }>("SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id = $1", [order.customerId]);
evidence.why: A query runs inside the for loop.

findings.suggestedFix: Use one query with LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id and COALESCE(c.name, '(deleted customer)').

reasons: Scripted verdict: the cited code shows the problem.
